bagPolicy.summary: Small personal bags and backpacks are allowed. Large backpacks are not permitted.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking is available at 1800 SAN PABLO LOT for a $20 flat rate and at FRANKLIN PLAZA GARAGE for a $25 flat rate during event hours. Public transportation via the 19th Street BART station is highly encouraged.

rideshare.note: Lyft is the official rideshare partner of Fox Theater.

concessions.note: The Den at the Fox Theater offers a gourmet menu and specialty cocktails for ticket holders. It is a sophisticated bar open an hour before showtime, providing a convenient entry to the theater.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Fox Theater, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Fox Theater's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The will call window opens 30 minutes prior to doors at the Fox Theater box office. The Will Call window opens approximately 30 minutes prior to doors for each show at the Fox Theater box office.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Fox Theater. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
